from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        debate = operator.Debate(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=4, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.STAR_BATTLE_DEBATE_PROMPT] * 4, aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.STAR_BATTLE_DEBATE_AGG_PROMPT, n_rounds=2)
        draft = await debate(problem)
        seq = operator.Sequential(llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=2, prompts=[prompt_custom.STAR_BATTLE_VERIFY_PROMPT, prompt_custom.STAR_BATTLE_FORMAT_PROMPT])
        solution = await seq(draft["response"])
        return solution["response"], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }

Solve the star-battle puzzle and critique competing proposals.

Puzzle:
{problem}

Other agent proposals from this round:
{all_proposals}

You are agent {agent_id} in round {round}.

- propose one complete candidate board or revise your prior idea
- explicitly reject any proposal that changes an X, has not exactly 1 star in each row/column, or has any horizontal/vertical/diagonal adjacency
- pay extra attention to diagonal adjacency between consecutive rows
- if a proposal fails, backtrack and try a different placement pattern

Return only one candidate in exactly this format:

Final Board:
<begin_board>
[board]
<end_board>
"""
